reasons.bare_month_end: A month without year is the workdate's year on the end side too (legacy moved it to the past).
reasons.month_last_next: 'scorso'/'prossimo' after or before a month pick the latest/next such month; legacy ignored the word or failed.
reasons.quarter_forms: Quarters accept q/t forms in both languages, with the year before or after; legacy failed on them.
reasons.day_month_name: Day + month name + year is a date; legacy failed.
reasons.comma_removed: Commas are removed and no longer separate bounds.
reasons.pivot_year: Two-digit years use one pivot_year window on the workdate; legacy dates via Babel were always 20xx.
reasons.whole_words: Keywords match whole words, not substrings.
reasons.no_time: Times are not part of a period; legacy returned a datetime.
reasons.unsupported_locale: Only shipped languages are supported; legacy read month names from Babel.
